text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wowzers! Look at all those rides! The
city really is
amaz'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
At Yukino Bijin's request, we've come to
check
out an amusement park in the city.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There're so many people—it's practic'lly
a festival!
This is someth'n else!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's all that hubbub over there
about? Is
everyone flock'n to a new
swanky ride?

text_block_list.name: Actor A
text_block_list.text:
Stop dodging the question! You actually
want to
get back into racing, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Actor B
text_block_list.text: You came all the way here just to ask me about racing? ...Come on, you can't just tell people how they should feel about something!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer! Are they film'n a TV show
right now?!
I've seen those actors b'fore!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hot dog! They're even more dazzl'n in
real life!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And it's not just 'bout their looks and

mannerisms—it's the way they're so
poised! And
d'termined to really step
into their roles!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I just can't take my peepers off 'em...
Even from
this far away, they're just
plain mesmeriz'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
That's a pair of bona fide city girls right
there!
And someday... I'll be one too...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's expression changes. She
still looks
happy, but her eyes seem to
twinkle with her
hopes and dreams.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
What?! I mean, I do wanna be like

them—enchant'n inside and out...
choice_data_list: ユキノもドラマに出てみたいか？
ユキノもドラマに出てみたい？

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And if I could act onstage right
alongside 'em, I
bet that'd get me closer
to the glitz and glam of a
city girl too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But... there's noth'n special about me, so
all that's
just wishful think'n. Haha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Yukino Bijin shrinks back a little, the
words she
spoke a minute ago come to
mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Someday... I'll be one too..."
Is she
really that far away from realizing that

dream? At the very least, she's closer
than she
thinks...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure she could manage a minor
role
with only a few lines and
appearances...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hi there. I've brought what you asked
for, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer asked if there were any
small roles
open in any TV shows.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I picked out a few. Do you want to go
through
them with me, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I think the last one—the

student—would be best for you. It's
easier to play
a role you can relate to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! Hold on a second!
choice_data_list: 確かにこれなら大丈夫そう

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You want me?! on TV?! What?! Have you
two
both gone cuckoo?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You want to act, don't you? I know
you've got
what it takes, Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
There's no way! I mean, I'm interested,
sure, b-but
there's no way I'm good
'nuff!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You do?
choice_data_list: そんなことない！ユキノなら絶対できるよ！
ドラマに出ているユキノを見てみたい

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Being an actor is about more than just
looking
good. It's a profession that
actually involves lots
of hard work and
commitment.
choice_data_list: なんでも頑張って取り組むユキノなら！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: That's why I think you'd be suited to it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer... City...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I... I'll do it!
choice_data_list: チャレンジしてみようよ！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'll step up to the plate and knock
ev'ryone's
socks off with my act'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Presented with an opportunity to act on
TV,
Yukino Bijin vows to give the
performance all
she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having made up her mind, Yukino Bijin's
eyes
burn with determination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Jeepers! I can't even picture it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You keep putting yourself down, but I
really think
you've got what it takes.
choice_data_list: 絶対、素晴らしいドラマになるよ！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
And I'm a model, so you should know my
word
counts for something.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um!
choice_data_list: そうそう！ユキノはすごく魅力的だよ！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to be a city girl, I'm
pretty sure
you'll need both confidence
and experience, so
how about it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I s'pose you're right...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I can't chicken out if I wanna be a real
city girl!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Get me on that TV show! I'm gonna
buckle right
down and make you two
proud as peacocks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Presented with an opportunity to act on
TV,
Yukino Bijin vows to give the
performance all
she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Summoning all her courage, she's ready
to take
on this brand-new challenge.
